title: Software engineer
summary: Designs, builds and maintains software. Employers hire on skill: there is no licence and no mandatory exam.

milestones.title: Physics and Maths in class 11 and 12, to keep the B.Tech route open
milestones.detail: For B.E. or B.Tech admission through JEE Main at NITs, IIITs and other centrally funded institutes, class 12 must include Physics, Mathematics, a language, one of Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology or a technical vocational subject, and one more subject.

milestones.title: JEE Main, for B.E. or B.Tech in Computer Science
milestones.detail: There is no age limit; you can sit it in the year you pass class 12 and the two years after. Paper 1 covers Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. NITs and IIITs also need 75% in class 12 (65% for SC, ST and PwD candidates) or a place in your board's top 20 percentile. Their seats are allotted through JoSAA and CSAB.

milestones.title: A four-year B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
milestones.detail: AICTE's model curriculum sets 163 credits over four years, with summer internships built in so students work on real industry problems.
